ui.shell.menubar.file.role: Electron application-menu item, top-level menu or one entry inside it
ui.shell.menubar.file.tone: Native menu voice: Title Case stand-alone item, no trailing full stop, the wording the platform's own menus use.
ui.shell.menubar.file.length: One to four words. The macOS menu column is narrow, so a longer phrase pushes the shortcut column out.
ui.shell.menubar.file.note: English source: File. Shown in the application menu, outside the window, so it does not follow a renderer reload.
